note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Sierra Leone: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Read again 2026-11-03 at the source: the Employment Act, 2023 (s. 95) on SierraLII (sierralii.gov.sl) gives the fifteen and the eighteen for harmful work; it also sets light work from thirteen (s. 96) and bars night work and overtime under eighteen, not held. The Acts read define a child as under eighteen but name no age of majority, which still rests on the State's report (the Child Rights Act 2007 isn't on SierraLII).

figures.finding: Sierra Leone reports its age of majority as eighteen.
figures.applies: Sierra Leone; the State's 2025 report (the Child Rights Act 2007 defines a child as under 18).

sources.said: The age of majority in Sierra Leone is 18 years.

figures.finding: Sierra Leone reports a Minimum Age for Work Declaration of fifteen for non-hazardous work and eighteen for hazardous work, with the Employment Act 2023 (Part X) on children's hazardous work.

sources.said: Minimum Age for Work Declaration: 15 years for non-hazardous work, 18 years for hazardous work
(1) A child under the age of 15 years shall not be employed to perform work in a workplace .

(4) A child under the age of 18 years shall not work or be employed to perform any work that is likely to jeopardise his health , safety, physical, mental, spiritual, moral or social development, or to interfere with his education.

sources.title: Sierra Leone: combined sixth and seventh periodic reports, CRC/C/SLE/6-7 (2025, issued 7 July 2026)
sources.said: The age of majority in Sierra Leone is 18 years. … Minimum Age for Work Declaration: 15 years for non-hazardous work, 18 years for hazardous work

sources.title: Employment Act, 2023 (Act No. 15 of 2023), SierraLII (sierralii.gov.sl, the Government of Sierra Leone's legal information institute), ss. 95, 96
sources.said: 95. Child labour (1) A child under the age of 15 years shall not be employed to perform work in a workplace . (2) A child under the age of 18 years shall not be employed to perform work underground. (3) A child below the age of 18 years shall not be employed on night work or engaged for overtime work. (4) A child under the age of 18 years shall not work or be employed to perform any work that is likely to jeopardise his health , safety, physical, mental, spiritual, moral or social development, or to interfere with his education. ... 96. Minimum age for light work (1) The minimum age for the engagement of a child in light work shall be 13 years.
